checkpoint: new engineering-only canonical JSON hex tensors with complete model/AdamW/private RNG/history and source/environment bindings; bounded prefix replay-to-resume from declared seed; no native checkpoint import
claims: trainable-scale forward/surrogate/positive handling and full tiny optimizer replay correctness only; no learning improvement, speedup, research activation, release or weight-format selection
forward: CPU float32 U=W/s; round ties to even then clamp [-1,+1]; int8 codes; actual float32 codes*s returned directly; +/-0.5 ties zero
interpretation: independent LSQ-inspired symmetric ternary adaptation, not four-level signed two-bit LSQ replication
objective: single mean cross entropy over all six synthetic target positions; arbitrary numeric byte-token fixture, no task accuracy or EOS claim; no auxiliary objective

optimizer.name: existing native create_optimizer AdamW single tensor

order: private CPU generator seed; randperm(2) each update; both arms same row order; model native private initialization seed; global RNG untouched
paper: Esser et al., Learned Step Size Quantization, ICLR 2020, https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.08153
positive_scale: reject s< float32(1e-8), nonfinite or nonscalar; after each AdamW step reject nonfinite scale then project to min float32(1e-8); optimizer moments unchanged; no upper clamp
scale: one CPU float32 scalar per attention/FF linear matrix; absmean initialized using float64 reduction then floor 1e-8 and float32 cast; frozen control same initial values and nontrainable scales
scale_surrogate: h=-1 for U<=-1, h=+1 for U>=1, else code-U; sum(g.double()*h.double())/sqrt(N); cast float32 and reject nonfinite; h formed via clamped U to avoid inf subtraction
weight_surrogate: g where abs(U)<1 else zero; boundary +/-1 excluded
